metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over South Los Angeles, California lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 (tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density) - Dates: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: South Los Angeles, California (approximately 33.95°N, 118.25°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Use qa_value >= 0.75 to filter quality pixels for Sentinel-5P - This is about NO2 concentration, not clouds, so quality masking is appropriate 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Compare 2021 vs both 2018 and 2019 - Valid Zero: NO2 can be very low but should be positive - C3 if None/NaN/negative values - A if 2021 < both 2018 AND 2019 - B otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define South Los Angeles area const southLA = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.25, 33.95]).buffer(10000); // 10km radius // Function to mask poor quality pixels function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get NO2 data for each period const no2_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24') .filterBounds(southLA) .map(maskQuality) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const no2_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24') .filterBounds(southLA) .map(maskQuality) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const no2_2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24') .filterBounds(southLA) .map(maskQuality) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const size_2018 = no2_2018.size().getInfo(); const size_2019 = no2_2019.size().getInfo(); const size_2021 = no2_2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images: 2018=${size_2018}, 2019=${size_2019}, 2021=${size_2021}`); if (size_2018 === 0 || size_2019 === 0 || size_2021 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each period const mean_2018 = no2_2018.mean(); const mean_2019 = no2_2019.mean(); const mean_2021 = no2_2021.mean(); // Get statistics const stats_2018 = mean_2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats_2019 = mean_2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats_2021 = mean_2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val_2018 = stats_2018['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count_2018 = stats_2018['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const val_2019 = stats_2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count_2019 = stats_2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const val_2021 = stats_2021['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count_2021 = stats_2021['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`2018: Mean=${val_2018}, Pixels=${count_2018}`); console.log(`2019: Mean=${val_2019}, Pixels=${count_2019}`); console.log(`2021: Mean=${val_2021}, Pixels=${count_2021}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count_2018 === 0 || count_2019 === 0 || count_2021 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid values if (val_2018 === null || val_2019 === null || val_2021 === null || isNaN(val_2018) || isNaN(val_2019) || isNaN(val_2021) || val_2018 < 0 || val_2019 < 0 || val_2021 < 0) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: 2021 should be lower than BOTH 2018 and 2019 if (val_2021 < val_2018 && val_2021 < val_2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
